title: The Paper Interviews #2 with Chelsea Frei

sentences.en: Welcome to another special Friday episode of Office Ladies.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看本期《办公室女士》的周五特别节目。

sentences.en: This week, we are sharing our interview with Chelsea Fry from The Paper.
sentences.zh: 本周，我们将分享对《大人物》中切尔西·弗莱的采访。

sentences.en: The Paper is coming out on September 4th on Peacock,
sentences.zh: 《大人物》将于9月4日在Peacock平台上线，

sentences.en: and we found out they are planning to release the first four episodes.
sentences.zh: 我们得知他们计划首播前四集。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We got our links to view them before they air.
sentences.zh: 我们在播出前就拿到了观看链接。

sentences.en: Yes, they sent us the first four episodes.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们给我们发来了前四集。

sentences.en: I am so excited.
sentences.zh: 我太兴奋了。

sentences.en: This is one of the benefits of being part of the Office universe.
sentences.zh: 这是作为“办公室”宇宙一部分的福利之一。

sentences.en: We get to see these shows early, and, lady, I am here for it.

sentences.en: I know.

sentences.en: We get to see them, but we do have to wait to do our breakdown until after the show has premiered,

sentences.en: because no spoilers.

sentences.en: Yeah, so until then, we have to keep everything to ourselves.
sentences.zh: 是啊，所以在那之前，我们得守口如瓶。
